meta: What is an AI jailbreak? Some people trick AI into breaking its rules to do things it normally refuses. That trick is called a jailbreak.

muc.title: Tricking AI into breaking rules
muc.text: Some people trick AI into breaking its rules to do things it normally refuses. That trick is called a jailbreak.

muc.title: Role-play and roundabout stories
muc.text: They often make AI play a role, tell a roundabout story, or split a harmful request into many small steps.

muc.title: Why it's dangerous
muc.text: The danger is that AI could give harmful instructions, and people who try it can get their accounts banned.

muc.title: Many layers of guardrails
muc.text: AI companies block it in layers: training the model to spot tricks, adding filters, and patching new holes quickly.

muc.title: Ask about AI's limits
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to list the things it refuses to do, and the reason for each.
